rows.text: So there was an article about escorts getting rich off AI workers. A lot of the prostitutes that hang out around rationalist circles seem to simultaneously talk about how rich they are and to constantly be launching schemes to make more money and live in situations that are not commensurate with the level of claimed wealth. Maybe they're saving aggressively. But part of me just thinks they're lying. Does anyone have any verification that they're actually booking significant numbers of clients while charging 10x what other escorts are charging?

Mearsheimer has predicted 10 of the last 2 US misadventures abroad. Including, somehow, wars the US isn't participating in. I wouldn't take him seriously on most things.

As for US stocks: the US is the only major advanced manufacturing economy that's a net energy exporter. (Norway, Canada, etc too but they're smaller.) If there's a major oil shock the US will be affected least. Not unaffected, just affected least. If your output drops by 10% and your competitors by 50% (to pick a number) you end up relatively ahead and investor money wants to capture that.

More generally, the US is the only major advanced economy that doesn't have major, structural underlying weaknesses. It has one major issue, a spending problem, which all its competitors have too and which is solvable in a way demographic decline or decades of stagnation and overregulation aren't. The US has problems. Everyone else just has more. So in times of instability capital flees to the US as it has for a long time. And the world is getting less stable.
